newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares fall further amid political tension.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares fall further amid political tension.

text.p: Istanbul shares extended losses as selling accelerated amid ongoing political tension on Monday afternoon, brokers said.
The IMKB National-100 fell 61 points, or 3.78 percent to a day's low 1,551 at mid-session.
Brokers said selling also increased as support awaited at around the 1,580 level was broken. The following support level is seen at 1,500.
